## Scope and firewall

Stage 0, Stage A and Stage B frozen anchors remain immutable. Stage C fixes TD000 (108 circles), K<=8 and the frozen cyclic/oriented-D6 representation. No teacher expansion, K expansion, parser/context expansion, R057-X new comparison, or later-stage work was performed.

Cross-arm provenance is explicit: every new OP001/G001-family object is `CROSS_ARM_INSPIRED_POST_SERIOUS_CHECKPOINT`, sourced only from R057X Stage-A role-level H3/H5 transfer/compression proposal (`d1069eb5f7f99be72e41fdc6ba4507c3cd2becb490da83171a2f12804419fef0`). G teacher center, tangent, radius, coordinates, and the frozen G fitted coefficient were not imported or tested as A-side features/constants.

## OP001 retained A-native generators

1. `CHORD_DEFECT = IDENTITY_PACKET(k) - WHOLE_CHORD(k)` using only k and endpoint Q.
2. `SIGNED_BULGE_DENSITY = A2/k`, where `A2` is the exact lattice-determinant shoelace sum of the packet polyline closed by its endpoint chord.
3. `TURN_QUADRATIC_MOMENT_DENSITY = sum_i (2i-(m-1))^2 t_i / m^3`, a signed reversal-even turn-word moment.
4. `RUN_SWITCH_DENSITY = number of adjacent sign switches /(m-1)`.

All four are invariant under the frozen oriented-D6 action. Two screened candidates (`TURN_SUM_DENSITY`, `ENDPOINT_MISMATCH_DENSITY`) were not promoted into OP001.

G004 removes the K7-only gate and applies one four-generator formula to every k=2..8; it still beats the 59-rule lookup MSE with description units 86.

## K07-C0011 exception

Under G002 the former hard-coded exception is not named by class ID. Its A-native feature signature is `A2=12`, signed bulge density `12/7`, and run-switch density `3/5`. The shared formula gives exact correction `34/1155`, which is the **largest positive correction among all 15 K7 classes**. Thus the signed correction naturally identifies the exceptional role and direction without a class lookup. It does **not** reproduce the exact OP000 `[3,4]` local-length increment (about 0.37014); the G002 correction is much smaller and operates through global cyclic tiling competition.

It uses an 8-state min-plus cyclic automaton distinct from the synthesis cut-window DP, verifies all screened feature generators under all 6 rotations and 6 orientation-restored reflections for all 65 packet classes, recomputes all four selected models, and checks cyclic/reflection invariance on all 108 teachers for G002 and G004.
